seasonalTasks.title: Winter pruning (dormant)
seasonalTasks.body: Cane prune to 4-arm Kniffin or umbrella Kniffin. 80% of last year's wood removed.

seasonalTasks.title: Shoot thinning at 6 in
seasonalTasks.body: Remove non-count shoots and weak shoots from cordon to balance crop.

seasonalTasks.title: Pre-bloom mancozeb / copper
seasonalTasks.body: Black rot + downy mildew + powdery mildew window. M03 mancozeb 3 lb/A.

seasonalTasks.title: Post-bloom cover
seasonalTasks.body: FRAC 11 strobilurin or FRAC 7 SDHI — alternate from M03.

seasonalTasks.title: Concord harvest
seasonalTasks.body: Brix ≥ 16 + characteristic foxy aroma. Single-pass mechanical or hand.

notes: Slip-skin American grape — juice + jam. Most disease-tolerant of common cultivars.
